blind.description: A rectangular section of heavy prison or cell bars consisting of a sturdy outer frame, two horizontal support crossbars, and six vertical cylindrical bars spaced evenly across. The metal has a slightly hand-forged, weathered dark cast-iron or bronze texture with subtle highlights on worn edges. Surfaces are solid and fully connected with no detached, floating, or broken elements.
blind.from_above: A long, straight dark horizontal bar with slightly squared, blocky ends representing the top rail and post caps.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 5 feet tall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
